evidence: Every third-party CI action reference resolves to an immutable commit SHA, not a movable tag
expected_output: One observation row per `uses:` reference across all workflows, with workflow, action, pinned_to_sha

assertions.description: Every third-party action is pinned to a 40-hex commit SHA; a tag can be force-moved to attacker-controlled code.

notes: Repo-local actions (./…) move with the commit and count as pinned; unevidenced when the repo has no CI workflows at all.
